object.name: evi_curve
object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP <o>curve~</o> in gen abstraction form
object.description: evi_curve is almost identical to MSP <o>curve~</o> (without list processing of course) providing exact ramp destination time and curve parameter. In gen~ this is expensive and therefore not so useful. Based on Graham Wakefield's original example (which is no longer present in the gen~ examples folder).

inlets.name: ramp
inlets.digest: Amount of time the value takes to reach it's destination. evi_curve reaches it's destination exactly in this time.

inlets.name: curve
inlets.digest: Exponential curvature of the ramp. In evi_curve (as opposed to MSP curve~) this value never becomes very sharp at the extremes of this setting, but retains a small amount of curvature, due to the approximations used in the calculations.

outlets.name: exact
outlets.digest: Smoothed output ramp, or target value if ramp is complete.

outlets.digestauto: When Ramp Reaches Destination (0 During Ramp)
outlets.digest: 1 When Ramp Reaches Destination (0 During Ramp).
